title: Qwen-Image-HD: Autoregressive Diffusion for High Definition Image Generation
abstract: Fine-tuning a generator on a complete high-resolution canvas requires long image sequences and substantial computation, yet local regions can still exhibit unnatural repetitive stripes when training resources are limited. We introduce Qwen-Image-HD, which adapts Qwen-Image 2.0 to high-resolution synthesis through local training and blockwise autoregressive generation. Each prediction covers a target tile at 1K scale, conditioned on high-resolution upper and left neighbors and a compressed historical thumbnail. These conditions provide adjacent fine-scale structures and an overview of the scene generated so far. To integrate these complementary cues, we map both forms of history and the target to a shared canvas coordinate system to express their spatial relationships and scale differences. On Qwen-Image-Bench at 4K, Qwen-Image-HD achieves stronger overall evaluation performance than direct 4K generation with FLUX-3-Image-Klein. Compared with full-image 4K supervised fine-tuning of the same backbone, it achieves better generation quality with lower training compute and higher inference efficiency, while exhibiting fewer unnatural repetitive stripes in original-resolution comparisons. We further introduce a Wavefront-AutoRegressive inference schedule that generates tiles on the same anti-diagonal concurrently across GPUs to reduce single-image latency.

summary.title_zh: Qwen-Image-HD：用于高清图像生成的自回归扩散模型
summary.core_contribution: 提出Qwen-Image-HD，通过局部训练和分块自回归生成将Qwen-Image 2.0适配到高分辨率合成，在降低训练计算量的同时提升生成质量并减少重复条纹伪影。
summary.method: 每个预测覆盖1K尺度的目标图块，以高分辨率的上方和左侧邻块以及压缩的历史缩略图为条件。将两种历史形式与目标映射到共享画布坐标系，以表达空间关系和尺度差异。采用分块自回归生成，并引入Wavefront-AutoRegressive推理调度，在GPU上并行生成同一反对角线上的图块以降低单图延迟。
summary.findings: 在Qwen-Image-Bench的4K评测中，Qwen-Image-HD整体评估性能优于FLUX-3-Image-Klein的直接4K生成。与同骨干的全图4K监督微调相比，它以更低训练计算量和更高推理效率获得更好生成质量，且在原始分辨率对比中重复条纹伪影更少。

title: MAGPIE: Agentic Multi-Reference Image Generation via Executable Scene Construction
abstract: Multi-reference image generation requires a model to preserve the appearance of selected subjects while arranging them according to an instruction. Despite recent progress in reference-based generation and compositional control, reliably organizing selected subjects into the intended scene remains challenging. Although existing methods provide various forms of compositional guidance, the planned relationships are not always explicitly instantiated for inspection and refinement before image synthesis. To address this limitation, we introduce MAGPIE, which represents the intended composition as a simplified 3D scene defined by an executable Blender program. A coding agent links each scene instance to its reference, checks the geometry and rendered view against the instruction, and revises the program to correct discrepancies. The final proxy rendering serves as a visual plan for the image generator. Using MAGPIE-Instruct-3K, we train the generator to follow this plan while drawing each subject's appearance from its reference. MAGPIE improves both Qwen and FLUX on DreamOmni2 and SconeEval. With FLUX, it improves overall success on DreamOmni2 by 28.21 percentage points over the original backbone and achieves the highest overall score among the models evaluated on SconeEval.

summary.title_zh: MAGPIE：通过可执行场景构建的智能体多参考图像生成
summary.core_contribution: 提出MAGPIE框架，将多参考图像生成中的目标构图表示为可执行的Blender 3D场景程序，通过编码智能体进行规划、检查和修正，从而在图像合成前显式实例化并验证场景关系。
summary.method: MAGPIE将预期构图表示为一个由可执行Blender程序定义的简化3D场景。编码智能体将每个场景实例链接到其参考图像，对照指令检查几何结构和渲染视图，并修改程序以纠正偏差。最终的代理渲染作为图像生成器的视觉规划。作者构建了MAGPIE-Instruct-3K数据集，训练生成器遵循该规划，同时从参考图像中提取每个主体的外观。
summary.findings: MAGPIE在DreamOmni2和SconeEval基准上均提升了Qwen和FLUX模型的表现。使用FLUX时，在DreamOmni2上的整体成功率相比原始骨干模型提升了28.21个百分点，并在SconeEval上取得了所评估模型中的最高总体得分。

title: FlowVecFont: Scalable Vector Font Generation via Latent Flow Matching
abstract: Fonts are natively represented as vector outlines. Many existing studies on vector font generation have relied on specialized generation or refinement mechanisms, bitmap representations, or externally pretrained models to address the challenges of learning vector representations. These approaches often increase system complexity, incur additional computational and implementation costs, and introduce dependencies on external resources. We show that scaling a simple model enables high-quality pure vector font generation without external pretraining. We propose FlowVecFont, a scalable model for vector font generation based on latent flow matching and trained solely on vector outlines. A Transformer-based variational autoencoder maps glyph sequences into fixed-length continuous latent tokens, enabling standard conditional flow matching for vector glyph generation. The model supports conditioning on class labels or reference glyphs, with the latter enabling generalization to unseen characters and fonts. Experiments on 5M glyphs collected across Google Fonts, including non-Latin characters, show that generation quality improves with model scale across conditioning strategies. In a comparison on Latin glyphs, the 800M-parameter FlowVecFont outperforms DeepVecFont-v2 and DesigNet and achieves quality competitive with the pretrained 27B-parameter VecGlypher. We also provide TorchFont, a machine learning library for vector fonts.

summary.title_zh: FlowVecFont：基于潜在流匹配的可扩展矢量字体生成
summary.core_contribution: 论文提出FlowVecFont，证明仅通过扩展一个简单模型即可实现高质量的纯矢量字体生成，无需外部预训练或位图表示，并发布了矢量字体机器学习库TorchFont。
summary.method: 该方法基于潜在流匹配，仅使用矢量轮廓进行训练。首先用基于Transformer的变分自编码器将字形序列映射为固定长度的连续潜在token，再在此基础上应用标准条件流匹配进行矢量字形生成。模型支持以类别标签或参考字形作为条件，后者可泛化到未见过的字符和字体。
summary.findings: 在从Google Fonts收集的500万个字形（含非拉丁字符）上的实验表明，生成质量随模型规模增大而提升，且在不同条件策略下均成立。在拉丁字形的对比中，800M参数的FlowVecFont优于DeepVecFont-v2和DesigNet，并与预训练的27B参数VecGlypher质量相当。

title: Let The Pixels Through: Rethinking Long Skip Connections for Scalable Pixel Diffusion
abstract: Training pixel diffusion models remains less straightforward, owing to the ad hoc training recipes and architecture designs, along with the sensitivity to hyper-parameter choices. We show that strong denoisers can be built by refining existing pixel-native designs from the literature. Specifically, we revisit the long skip connection in U-Net and find that the optimization benefit commonly attributed to it is not necessary for its denoising benefit. We further find that the conventional linear combination of features from the skip and main backbone is inadequate for regimes of various noise levels. Motivated by these observations, we introduce two core modifications. First, we adopt asymmetric long skips, which propagate fine-grained information from input embeddings to decoder layers. Second, we introduce adaGLU, a SwiGLU-like MLP block, in decoder layers to adaptively filter information from the embeddings before being added to main-branch features. The above designs give a simple pixel diffusion transformer architecture. When trained from scratch, it scales smoothly from small-scale baselines up to 1.6B parameters, achieving 1.62 and 1.70 FID on ImageNet-256 and -512, respectively. Besides, it natively supports multimodal inputs, such as text and images, yielding competitive performance in text-to-image generation. We release our codes at https://github.com/AMAP-ML/PiT

summary.title_zh: 让像素通过：重新思考可扩展像素扩散中的长跳跃连接
summary.core_contribution: 论文重新审视了U-Net中的长跳跃连接，发现其优化益处对去噪并非必要，且传统线性特征组合在不同噪声水平下不充分，据此提出非对称长跳跃和adaGLU模块，构建了可平滑扩展至1.6B参数的简单像素扩散Transformer架构。
summary.method: 作者首先分析现有像素原生设计，发现长跳跃连接的优化益处与去噪益处可分离，且线性特征组合不适应多噪声水平。为此，采用非对称长跳跃将输入嵌入的细粒度信息传播到解码器层，并在解码器层引入类似SwiGLU的adaGLU MLP块，在嵌入特征与主分支特征相加前自适应过滤信息。该设计形成简单的像素扩散Transformer，从头训练可从小规模基线平滑扩展至1.6B参数。
summary.findings: 该模型在ImageNet-256和ImageNet-512上分别达到1.62和1.70 FID，并原生支持文本和图像等多模态输入，在文本到图像生成中取得有竞争力的性能。

title: Distill to Loop: Turning Pretrained Diffusion Transformers into Looped Models with Adjustable Depth
abstract: Looped transformers reuse one block of shared weights along the depth of the network. Recent looped diffusion transformers are trained from scratch, which repeats the full pretraining cost although strong pretrained non-looped diffusion transformers exist. We propose Distill to Loop (Dooop), which distills a pretrained non-looped diffusion transformer into a looped student whose blocks are initialized from the teacher's. We cast distillation as a fixed-point iteration toward the teacher, in which the output after every loop is trained toward the teacher, and each loop is one step of an ordinary differential equation in depth. As a result, one model runs any number of loops at test time without retraining, and the higher-order ODE solvers of diffusion model sampling can be applied along the depth dimension for better results. Meanwhile, because a looped model produces an output after every loop, we also construct loop guidance between the outputs of different loop counts, which improves the generated samples at little extra compute. On SD3-medium, a looped student with about 37% of the teacher's parameters matches the teacher on average over GenEval, ImageReward, PickScore and HPSv2.1 with two to four loops, and with two loops it uses about 58% of the teacher's compute. And on a four-step SD3-medium, loop guidance raises the average of the four metrics from 88.2 to 99.2.

summary.title_zh: 蒸馏至循环：将预训练扩散Transformer转化为可调深度的循环模型
summary.core_contribution: 提出Dooop方法，通过蒸馏将预训练的非循环扩散Transformer转化为循环学生模型，使其在测试时无需重新训练即可运行任意数量的循环，并支持沿深度维度应用高阶ODE求解器。
summary.method: 将蒸馏视为向教师模型的固定点迭代，每个循环的输出都训练逼近教师模型，且每个循环对应深度方向ODE的一步。循环学生模型的块从教师模型初始化，测试时可运行任意循环数。同时利用不同循环数输出构建循环引导，以少量额外计算提升生成样本质量。
summary.findings: 在SD3-medium上，参数量约为教师37%的循环学生模型在2-4个循环时于GenEval、ImageReward、PickScore和HPSv2.1上平均匹配教师性能，2个循环时计算量约为教师的58%。在四步SD3-medium上，循环引导将四项指标平均值从88.2提升至99.2。
